resale_co.name: Certificate of Continued Occupancy (CCO), Zoning Resale of Residential Dwelling
resale_co.issued_by: Borough of Park Ridge Zoning Office (Zoning Officer)
resale_co.lead_time: A two-week notice is required for all certificates. Both certificates are issued together and e-mailed within five business days after the inspection.
requirements: Review of Borough files for open building permits and zoning violations, and that utilities and taxes are current
Certificates will not be issued if taxes or utilities are delinquent or there are open building permits (clear these before applying)
Street numbers visible; no open-ended wires; no illegal conversions (for example one family to two-family)
Sump pump must not be connected to the sanitary sewer (Chapter 81A, no illicit connections)
Smoke detector and carbon monoxide certification from Park Ridge Fire Prevention (separate $100 check)
Submit only page 4 of the packet with two separate checks

fees.label: Certificate of Continued Occupancy (zoning), residential resale
fees.quote: The fee for the Certificate of Continued Occupancy is $125 and is payable to Borough of Park Ridge.

resale_co.how_to_apply: Read the Residential Resale packet, then submit page 4 (Application for Certificate of Continued Occupancy, Zoning Resale of Residential Dwelling) with two separate checks: $125 to Borough of Park Ridge (zoning CCO) and $100 to Park Ridge Fire Prevention (fire certificate). Give at least two weeks notice. You will get a call to set up the fire prevention inspection.

evidence.quote: The Borough of Park Ridge requires a smoke certificate and zoning certificate for the sale of your home.
Prior to the closing on the sale of residential property, two certificates are required by the Borough.
The fee for the Certificate of Continued Occupancy is $125 and is payable to Borough of Park Ridge.
A two-week notice is required for all certificates.
Certificates are good for 180 days from date of issue.
Certificates will not be issued if taxes or utilities are delinquent or you have any open building permits.
there are no illicit connections to the Borough's sewer system, i.e. sump pump.
SEPARATE CHECKS: ZONING CCO FEE: $125 / FIRE CCO FEE: $100

resale_co.notes: Park Ridge requires two certificates before closing on a residential sale: a zoning Certificate of Continued Occupancy ($125, Borough of Park Ridge) and a Smoke Detector & Carbon Monoxide Certification ($100, Park Ridge Fire Prevention), paid by two separate checks. The packet is dated 9/4/25 and is a scanned/OCR document, so some words are garbled; the contact e-mail addresses in it are not readable reliably, so none is listed. Phone for the Zoning Officer is 201-391-5673; Borough Hall is (201) 573-1800.

requirements: Smoke alarms: sealed 10-year lithium battery type; smoke detector outside each sleeping area and within 10 feet of bedrooms; one on each level of multi-level homes
Carbon monoxide alarm: 10-year battery or plug-in type, within 10 feet of each sleeping area (combination units are acceptable)
Hardwired systems must be fully functional and cannot be replaced with battery-only detectors
Central monitored fire alarms must be inspected by the owner's alarm company with a copy of the test report given to the Fire Official at the inspection
Fire extinguishers are no longer required (packet dated 9/4/25)

authorities.name: Park Ridge Fire Prevention (Fire Official, Borough of Park Ridge)
authorities.lead_time: Two-week notice required. You will receive a call to set up the inspection after the application is received; certificates are e-mailed within five business days after the inspection. No same-day reinspections.

fees.label: Smoke Detector & Carbon Monoxide Certification (Fire Certificate)
fees.quote: The fee for the Fire Certificate is $100 and is payable to Park Ridge Fire Prevention.

fees.label: Fire certificate reinspection
fees.quote: If necessary, a re-inspection fee of $50 will be charged.

authorities.how_to_apply: Submit the Residential Resale packet's page 4 with a $100 check payable to Park Ridge Fire Prevention (separate from the $125 zoning check). The Fire Official calls to schedule the inspection.

evidence.quote: The fee for the Fire Certificate is $100 and is payable to Park Ridge Fire Prevention.
If necessary, a re-inspection fee of $50 will be charged.
FIRE EXTINGUISHERS ARE NO LONGER REQUIRED.
THE INSPECTOR WILL NOT PERFORM SAME DAY RE-INSPECTIONS
Park Ridge Borough 0247 LEAID: 0247-001 Enf Auth. Municipal Fire Official John Hansen Phone (201) 391-2746 Email jotrhansen@gmail.com

fire_cert.notes: Park Ridge Fire Prevention issues the smoke/CO certificate together with the zoning CCO; the fee is a flat $100 with a $50 reinspection (no tiered late fee published). The packet says fire extinguishers are no longer required, matching P.L.2025, c.19. The NJ DCA LEA registry lists Park Ridge as a municipal (M) enforcing agency; the state fire directory (survey 3/31/2026) lists Fire Official John Hansen at (201) 391-2746 with a gmail address, while the Borough packet gives 201-573-1800 X 505. The Borough also posts a Waiver of Smoke/Carbon Monoxide Detector Inspection (signed and notarized by the purchasers) for homes that will be renovated before occupancy; it still mentions a fire extinguisher and a Continuing Certificate of Occupancy from the Construction Official.

other_items.label: Sump pump / sewer connection check
other_items.detail: The CCO checklist requires that the sump pump not be connected to the sanitary sewer (Chapter 81A, no illicit connections).

other_items.label: Taxes, utilities and open permits
other_items.detail: Certificates are not issued if taxes or utilities are delinquent or there are open building permits; clear these before applying.

other_items.label: Smoke/CO waiver for renovation purchases
other_items.detail: Purchasers can sign a notarized Waiver of Smoke/Carbon Monoxide Detector Inspection when the home will be renovated; the home cannot be occupied until the requirements are met.
